name: Amamori Hachiya
source:
A junior high schooler who volunteers at Azure Heron Agency as an assistant to private investigator [url=/c124599]Richter Kai[/url]. When Richter is working out of the office, he is left in charge of taking care of the office and Richter's pet albino parakeet.

[Edited from in-game Files entry]
